items.title: Len Manno Interview, 1959-02-06
items.q: a big band more or less of the style of Duke Ellington

ctx.x: sometimes things turn up that way what about Troy Floyd this colored band

San Antonio did you ever hear them never heard of I thought maybe they got through and you heard them now now but did you ever hear his band no 30s band a big band more or less of the style of Duke Ellington but it had a lot of nuanced guys in it and trying to trace them out

no I used to the only the only colored bands that I knew of course Cab Calloway and Jimmy Lunsford incidentally Jimmy Lunsford bass player Moses Allen was a student of mine I knew Jimmy quite well he was Prince the guy where was Moses Allen from do you know Memphis they were all from the same I can't remember which town they came from but the Lunsford band was a high school band and Lunsford was the band director and he organized them into this group and they were so good that they went out playing here and there…
